mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2021 Q1 FEDFUNDS at 0.07% was near historic lows
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering anticipatory monetary tightening that reduces equity risk appetite and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth >0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS <0.1% signals robust labor market conditions combined with ultra-low interest rates, generating positive equity returns through strengthened consumer spending and risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with monetary easing
failure_condition: The joint condition (PAYEMS growth >0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS <0.1%) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1400 thousand units signals strong housing demand, indicating sustained consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400 thousand units but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE (current month < prior month) signals improving labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE declined from 6.3% to 6.0% MoM in March 2021
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE declines MoM.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 100.0 signals a contraction in industrial production, indicating economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO at 105.583 in March 2021 was above 100
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST >1400 thousand units and INDPRO <105.0 signals housing demand outpacing industrial supply, generating inflationary pressure that triggers equity market corrections and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST at 1421.0 and INDPRO at 105.583 in March 2021
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST>1400 and INDPRO<105.0) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 260 and FEDFUNDS above 0.5% define a monetary tightening cycle, where rising inflation and interest rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:2021 Q1 CPIAUCSL at 264.793 and FEDFUNDS at 0.07%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.
